# audio-context

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: An AudioContext with one owner of its resume and close: openAudioContext(options?) builds the context and answers an OwnedAudioContext — ctx (an AudioGraphContext: the context typed without resume / suspend / close, for building the graph), requestResume() → running | closed (closed by this owner while the resume was pending — the teardown of a page left before any gesture, never a crash) and close() (once; a second call is a no-op). Any other rejection, an InvalidStateError on a context the owner did not close included, throws an AudioContextError carrying the caller's stack. Its lint rule (no-raw-audio-context) sends every other new AudioContext and raw .resume() promise here.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/chord/piano`
    - `apps/keyboard-party/party`
    - `apps/sonata/audio/engine`
    - `music/ambient`
- Exemptions:
  - Exempts itself from: `audio-context/no-raw-audio-context` — `web/internal/owned-audio-context.ts` (sanctioned)
  - Exempted by: `primitives/dom/audio-context` (0 debt)
- Web:
  - Exports (types):
    - `AudioGraphContext`
    - `OwnedAudioContext`
    - `ResumeOutcome`
  - Exports (values):
    - `AudioContextError`
    - `openAudioContext`
